dedupe_keys.name: igs real time service rts precise orbit and clock streams

description: The IGS Real-Time Service (RTS) provides real-time precise GNSS products so that applications can use them in place of ultra-rapid products. Contents: orbit and clock corrections and code and phase biases from several analysis-centre solutions, offered as an operational multi-GNSS service; the page also covers user access, products, formats, monitoring, contributors and station data providers. Producer: the IGS, built on its global network of stations, data centres and analysis centres, with the IGS having provided open-access GNSS data products since 1994. Coverage: global. The service enables precise point positioning and related uses such as time synchronisation and disaster monitoring. Access: streams and user-access instructions are described on the RTS pages; the page read did not state whether a login is required, so check the user-access page before relying on it. Licence and cost: the IGS describes its products as open access; no licence text was read. Caveats: this is a live stream, so past values require the archived IGS products, and availability depends on the contributing analysis centres. Simulation uses: real-time correction streams support studies of timing dependence, positioning resilience and disaster monitoring. The archived, post-processed counterpart is described in data-igs-gnss-products.
